title: RAID EVENTS: BOUNTY PILLAGER
why: The third raid event, the bounty pillager: a marked crew boss with a big score reward who hunts you. A 15 second warning shows a ring where he will come in, then a hostile pillager steps out of the streets with four times the health, a full rig of plate and a rich bag for his body to drop. He comes for you wherever you go, whether or not he has seen you, and the ring, the map mark and BOUNTY $1,500 follow him. Put him down yourself and the bounty is paid into your run score at once, in DEMO and in CAREER; if something else kills him nothing is paid. Stay alive for 150 seconds of the hunt and he slips away. He never touches your CAREER save: he is a wave kind of pillager with no grudge or rival filed.
now: The bounty pillager event: a marked crew boss hunts you, and downing him yourself pays 1,500.
